officialPortals.title: Ghana eVisa - Official Electronic Visa Application Portal

docs.text: Application letter requesting the residence permit
Two passport-sized photographs
Copy of bank statement or indenture
Copy of marriage certificate (where applicable)
Two guarantors with copies of Ghanaian passport or national ID
Letter of support from the principal guarantor
Signed bond form (completed at an Immigration Office)
Copy of Non-Citizen Identification card
Child's birth certificate and parental consent letter (for child dependants)

visaTypes: Work and Residence Permit (Missionaries/NGOs/ Immigrant Quota GIPC/Shareholders)

links.title: Work and Residence Permit (Missionaries/NGOs/ Immigrant Quota GIPC/Shareholders)

docs.text: Company business registration certificate (incorporation / commence business / business code)
GIPC registration certificate
Company's current tax clearance certificate
Company's audited accounts for the previous year
Medical report from the Ghana Immigration Clinic, Accra
Police report from the applicant's home country
Copy of passport bio-data page
Curriculum vitae and professional/educational certificates
Offer letter, appointment letter or contract of employment
Letter of support from the relevant Ministry, Department or Agency
Marriage certificate if married; copy of any previous residence permit
Copy of Non-Citizen Identification card

visaTypes: Emergency Entry Visa (EEV) / Visa on Arrival

links.title: Ghana eVisa - Official Electronic Visa Application Portal

docs.text: Passport valid at least 6 months beyond departure, with 3 blank pages
Recent passport photograph (plain light background, under 6 months old)
Confirmed return or onward ticket / itinerary
Proof of accommodation for the full stay, or host letter with host ID
Proof of sufficient funds (bank or card statement, last 3 months)
International yellow fever vaccination certificate

visaTypes: Study visa (issued by Ghana missions abroad)

docs.text: Letter of acceptance from the Ghanaian institution
Letter from the institution abroad stating purpose of visit and financial means
Application letter from the school to the Comptroller-General
Two recent passport-sized photographs
Copies of admission letter and school fee receipts
Bond, birth certificate, affidavit and guarantor letter where applicable
Passport (submitted with application) and copy of Non-Citizen ID card

links.title: Ghana eVisa - Official Electronic Visa Application Portal

docs.text: Passport valid at least 6 months beyond departure, with 3 blank pages
Recent passport photograph
Signed invitation letter from the host company stating purpose of trip
Signatory's ID (Ghana Card or passport bio-data; residence permit if non-Ghanaian)
Certified company registration documents
Company tax clearance certificate
Confirmed return or onward ticket
Proof of accommodation and host details

visaTypes: Emergency Entry Visa (EEV) / Visa on Arrival

links.title: Ghana eVisa - Official Electronic Visa Application Portal

docs.text: Application letter to the Comptroller-General stating origin, arrival date, length and purpose of stay, itinerary and lodging
Host's bank statement (personal applications)
Bio-data page of the host
Bio-data page of the visitor
Flight itinerary
Hotel reservation (where not staying with host)
Completed extension form and application letter
Two recent passport-size photographs
Photocopy of return ticket
Letter of support from a local institution (where applicable)
Copy of Non-Citizen ID card (stays over 3 months)
Passport submitted with the application
